The orchestrator owns: dependency gating, worktree creation, trust, launch, receipt monitoring, branch backup, and notification - in ONE window. Supersedes run_relay.ps1, run_solaris_repair.ps1, run_repair_heats.ps1, run_followon.ps1, heartbeat.ps1 and watch_relay.ps1.

'ultracode' produces NO warning, so it is recognised despite being absent from --help. Acceptance alone would have proved nothing - a silently-ignored flag returns OK exactly like an applied one.

legs.name: token benchmark
legs.note: THE SPINE. 'Cost stays flat, even on huge scenes' leads the positioning page and every other differentiator hangs off it. Architecturally sound, numerically unproven. Arm B is computed by serialising a scene - NOT by running a competitor's product, which would be neither fair nor necessary. Cost is NEVER reported without outcome: flat cost on a failed task is not a feature.

legs.name: rsi surface audit
legs.note: SYNAPSE ALREADY HAS AN RSI LOOP. routing/adaptation.py records tier outcomes per epoch and adjusts confidence thresholds - observation, aggregation, self-modification. agent/learning.py is the reward signal. memory/evolution.py is deprecated RSI. The health report says the router was 'not initialized', so the loop is WIRED and may never have CLOSED. Six questions, and Q1/Q2 demand evidence of EXECUTION not wiring.

legs.name: forensic scout
legs.note: READ-ONLY, research-first, and it goes ALONE. The market, the H22 native floor, and what actually kills tool adoption in VFX pipelines are the only inputs not already in this repo - and gathering them AFTER forming a view produces confirmation, not evidence. Zero recommendations; a scout that returns a strategy has stopped being a scout.

legs.name: tool inventory
legs.note: done. Receipt LOST in the same prune. Findings survive as R121-R122. What SYNAPSE DOES today, per tool, mapped to a real artist task. Every tool classified WORKS/PARTIAL/SCAFFOLD/UNREACHABLE/UNKNOWN with its evidence. This week found five Solaris tools registered, tested and completely unreachable - the gap between 'a tool exists' and 'a tool works' is this project's most reliable finding, and this measures it deliberately.

legs.name: pre-mortem
legs.note: THE LEG THAT MATTERS. Not a post-mortem - SYNAPSE has ZERO production users, so a retrospective would be narrative resting on nothing. 'It is Q2 2027, a mid-sized studio ran it for a quarter and stopped. Write the account.' Every failure mode names a mechanism that exists NOW with a file:line. Ranked by LIKELIHOOD not severity - studios drop tools over the annoying Tuesday thing, not the catastrophe.

legs.name: the plan
legs.note: What makes SYNAPSE novel to a mid-size studio, DERIVED from S0-S2 rather than asserted. 'Irrefutably positive' is not achievable; the target is legible value, survivable failure, no new burden. A tool missing the second is uninstalled after one incident however good the first is.

legs.name: ingest scout
legs.note: READ-ONLY. nodes.zip holds 5,034 pages version-pinned to 22.0.368 - a PAGE count, not a KNOWLEDGE count. Measures structure, the JOIN KEY (against the live runtime, because H9 found 385 documented ids that are wrong as names while labels resolve), coverage of the 161 new Copernicus nodes, the quality floor, :include: banners (one made a whole deprecated subsystem read as current), and the doc-vs-runtime deprecation disagreement. I1 is gated on it because the join key is a FINDING, not an assumption.

legs.note: Builds the extractor and the corpus against what I0 measured. The frontier gap is 161 new Copernicus nodes, SYNAPSE grounds 3. Provenance per ENTRY (VERIFIED-DOC + build), never summed with probe-derived grounding. A stub is recorded known-thin, not padded. Deprecation travels with the entry. NOTHING wires into RAG - U.6 found 15 phantom createNode sites already living there outside the emission gate.

legs.name: cost truth
legs.note: READ-ONLY, and it goes first because it settles T.1's PREMISE. The blueprint's Mile 1 cuts the tool surface 17,310 -> 2,000 on the reasoning that 8.6x over ceiling is not credible for a token economist. Anthropic charges a cache WRITE at 1.25x and a cache READ at 0.1x, and tool definitions are the most cache-stable content in any request - so if cached, the effective cost is ~1,731 and UNDER the ceiling. Those are opposite programmes: a months-long reduction, or a cache-control header. Nobody has measured which applies. Also asks whether GROUNDING dominates tools - C1 measured it at 113,411 tokens, 6.5x the whole tool surface, and it is not cacheable.

legs.name: tool surface census
legs.note: READ-ONLY, PARALLEL to E0 on a disjoint question - E0 asks what a turn COSTS, E1 asks what the surface IS. A total is not a plan. Decomposes 17,310 per tool into name / description / schema, because those three compress differently and only one risks correctness. Looks for concentration (is it 20 tools of 120?), duplicated schema fragments (free reduction, no capability lost), and DEAD SURFACE - a registered tool never called costs its full definition every turn, and S1 already found five Solaris tools registered, tested and unreachable. Ends with the honest counter-question: is 2,000 even reachable at 120 tools, or is the real decision FEWER tools rather than smaller ones.

legs.name: verdict schema + voice
legs.note: Blueprint Mile 3, moved up from Mile 7 because voice B is a DEPENDENCY of tier rotation - rotate the manifest without it and every rotation is a re-onboarding event. E0 supplied a second and stronger reason: the cache breakpoint wraps the WHOLE system prompt and the prompt is not static (E0-F5/F6), so every write is paid at 1.25x and every read misses, invisibly. If the model emits STRUCTURE instead of PROSE, register instruction comes out of the prompt - which is a large part of what makes it non-static. Two problems, one contract.

legs.name: probe layer
legs.note: Blueprint Mile 4. Routing is probe-derived, never config-declared - and this project has the receipts: hou.ActiveRender documented and absent, EXPECTED_HOUDINI_VERSION declared and never assigned, five Solaris tools registered and unreachable. A model list is the same shape of claim and fails the same way. Returns a structure, no panel work. Colour COMPUTED from probe age and quota, never stored; staleness degrades to GREY, never to green. Zero completion spend - count_tokens is free, completions are not.
